answer: A loose sheet is a small thing until the ink will not take. Proof of dyer vat via indigo dip log is the maker's proof: a cloth the dyer dips only after 11 dips run even, each dip timed by the dyer herself. The echo is the vat the sheets are couched from. The atlas is the press that squeezes the water out. The pulse is the loft the paper dries in. A forger must couch 15 sheets, press 15 sheets and true 15 sheets, an afternoon at the vat for paper that still cockles.
